Stage 6 is now a purely deterministic export gate. It exists to freeze meaning, not to touch it.
What Stage 6 does

Writes the LLM-authored fused output to disk

Uses JSON-with-notes so intent is preserved

Computes SHA256 for integrity

Returns export paths for downstream stages
